name: Cytek — Current

assets.contractNumber: primary Asset Data!Synced Contract: Contract Number; else supplement Asset Data!Synced Contract: Contract Number
assets.contractType: primary Asset Data!Synced Contract: Contract Type; else supplement Asset Data!Synced Contract: Contract Type
assets.contractEndDate: primary Asset Data!Synced Contract: Contract End Date
assets.productName: primary Asset Data!Product: Product Name; else supplement Asset Data!Product: Product Name
assets.facilityName: supplement Asset Data!shortened facility name; falls back to accountName
assets.stateZip: supplement Asset Data!State and Zip code
assets.contractStatus: derived at lookup: Activated if contractEndDate >= today, Expired if past, blank if none

products.partName: primary Pricing Data!Display Name; falls back to partNumber when blank
products.listPrice: primary Pricing Data!Unit Price (rounded to cents; 0 with priced=false when blank/zero)
products.netPrice: = listPrice (the workbook has no customer net price; 'Last Purchase Price' is internal cost and is not imported)
products.category: Service if Sale Unit is Year/2 Years/3 Years/Hour, or the row is priced but has no Item Internal ID; otherwise Parts

notes: Underlying data sheets are read directly; the workbook's FSE Input VLOOKUP formulas are not used.
Products without a usable list price are imported with priced=false so they remain searchable; the form asks for a price when one is selected.
Fields blank in the primary workbook were filled from the supplement for serials present in the primary; serials only in the supplement were not imported.
Where the account name differs between primary and supplement, carried-over address/contact may be out of date; all populated fields remain editable in the form.
